## Activity

During October 2025, River Outreach recorded 78 captures. This represents the site’s capture activity for the reporting month. The volume should continue to be reviewed through routine operational monitoring, with any material changes considered alongside local service activity and the availability of equipment and staff.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. A total of 2 captures were ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 2.6%. Recurring camera issues should be recorded with the service desk so that faults can be identified, monitored and addressed through the appropriate support process. Accurate logging will also help distinguish individual equipment problems from wider operational issues.

## Grading

Grading identified 12 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 0, indicating no delay at the median for the reporting period. Results requiring referral should continue to be managed through the established clinical pathway, with local teams maintaining appropriate follow-up and documentation. Overall, the activity and grading measures provide a concise view of River Outreach performance during October 2025 and should inform routine review of image quality, workflow and equipment support.
